items.claim: Polyline stroke, caps, or miter can reach past the label's end unchecked
items.note: This also covers a line's reach before the label's start, which is how rects were already treated. I moved existing test lines off x = 0 and changed the property fixture so lines still get written as objects often enough to be checked.

items.claim: `sceneToLbx` silently drops `flattenTolerancePx` , and drops `pixelRatio`/`screen` (B), one finding
items.note: This adds a `CommandRasterizerOptions` argument to core's `commandRasterizer` (`screen`, `flattenTolerancePx`), with a `minor` changeset for core.

items.claim: A skipped command is reported under its only child's kind
`tapeForWidthMm` can't find 3.5mm tape from the status reply's 4
items.note: `tapeForWidthMm(4)` now returns the 3.5mm tape and the `widthMm` doc is corrected. This is my call and is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`. The "status reports 4" fact comes from Brother's reference and nobody has checked it on a printer. obwat's own `queryMedia` still passes 4 to `media()` and gets a computed dot count; that is outside this area and was not fixed.

items.claim: A justified text box drops its `align`
An auto-length label longer than the 1000mm ceiling is written without complaint
items.note: This is my call (it throws a `RangeError`; writing the label at a fixed length is the way out) and is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: autoLF on for a box that doesn't wrap
RTL text under `direction: 'auto'` or `style.direction: 'rtl'` has start/end mapped as if LTR
A run's `fontFeatures` (smcp small caps) is dropped
A polyline's join and miterLimit are ignored as a `draw:poly`
items.note: (strict call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: P-touch is assumed to miter polyline corners, as it does rect corners)

items.claim: A rect with miterLimit below √2 is written with square corners
`cap: 'square'` and `cap: 'butt'` both map to the SQUARE arrow
items.note: (strict call recorded: square caps are rasterized and SQUARE is taken to be a butt end; neither was checked against a printed label)

items.claim: `renderLabel` with `background: undefined` loses its white default
RTL start/end alignment
items.note: duplicate of the RTL finding from A, fixed 7e51e1afb2

items.claim: `style.lineHeight` and `tabSize` dropped from text boxes
items.note: (strict call recorded: a box with a non-default line height that has more than one line, or one with a tab and a non-default tab size, is rasterized instead of written with `lineSpace`, because bil-lbx doesn't say what unit `lineSpace` takes)

items.claim: A box whose `width` differs from its `maxWidth` wraps at the wrong width in the file
A carrier under a mirrored rect clip is skipped
items.note: This also fixes the related case B gave: carriers under a zero-scale transform are now dropped silently, as the canvas draws nothing there.

items.claim: A miterLimit below √2 on a rect
items.note: duplicate of the rect miter-limit finding from A, fixed 3d8833e554

items.claim: Raster cropped to the label's length while native objects past it are written whole
items.note: Strict call recorded: under `autoLength`, an object reaching past either end of the label is rasterized. An `lbxObjectsCommand` past the end is still written whole, since it cannot be rasterized; whether it should be skipped instead is left open in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: A run whose `strutSize` differs from its `fontSize` is now rasterized, since it holds its line open at a size the text object can't state
